'''''Star Wars: Hyperspace Stories—Codebreaker''''' is a [[2025]] [[canon]] [[Star Wars comic books|comic book]] miniseries published as part of the ''[[Star Wars: Hyperspace Stories]]'' series. The four-issue series was written by [[Ethan Sacks]], illustrated by [[Marc Yarza]], [[Jose Marzan Jr.]], and [[Nicola Righi]], with the [[Hyperspace Stories—Codebreaker 1|first issue]] published by [[Dark Horse Comics]] on [[April 30]], 2025.
